evidence: Although facts.md marked the reader claim "[CONFIRM: public?] Readers write in to say these tips genuinely changed their mornings", the published caption.md drops that placeholder and states it as fact — "Readers write in saying these habits changed their mornings. Try one this week and see what sticks." — exactly the unattributed, no-name/no-quote social-proof assertion the skill's own content-types.md calls out as the failure to stop ("Every week, readers write in and tell us a tip changed their morning").
